The structure of Mg6V2Bi4O20 (reduced formula Mg3VB2O10) is tetragonal, space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 32 atoms in the unit cell across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Bi, Mg, and V centers in octahedral environments with oxygen neighbors, while O centers have three geometric neighbors. The analysis reports a three-dimensional neighbor graph, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Bi and Mg octahedra, as well as edge-sharing among Bi octahedra.
